s1.desc: a snowy yard beside a big igloo

spans.view: with a snowy fir tree beside the igloo

beats.text: Polly stands at the edge of the igloo with her back half turned, peering around it
Polly turns to face forward and shuffles along the igloo wall with her flippers out
Polly stands against the igloo and glances off to the side with wide eyes
Polly closes her eyes with a sly smile, her beak opening into a grin
Polly opens her eyes and peers off to one side, checking around her
Polly pulls a snack bag out from behind her back and hugs it to her chest
Polly digs a snack out of the bag and pops it into her beak
Polly munches with her eyes closed and a pleased smile, one flipper raised beside her face
